name: uk.co.batterypayback/battery-payback
title: Battery Payback
description: UK home battery payback estimates, tariffs and sourced battery specifications.

tools.name: calculate_payback
tools.description: Yearly saving and simple payback time of a home battery in the UK, from the user's own figures. Same model as the calculator on batterypayback.co.uk. Rates in pence per kWh.

daytime_share.description: Share of use between 8am and 4pm, 0-1. Default: the measured London profile (about 0.34, Low Carbon London smart meters).

cheap_hours_share.description: Share of use already in cheap-rate hours, 0-1. Default 0.

peak_rate_p.description: Normal or peak unit rate, p/kWh.

cheap_rate_p.description: Cheap-hours rate, p/kWh. Omit for a single-rate tariff.

charge_from_grid.description: Fill the battery at the cheap rate. Default true.

yearly_saving_decline.description: Optional yearly reduction of the saving, 0-0.2.

charge_power_kw.description: Optional battery charging power, kW. With cheap_window_hours it caps grid charging at power x hours a night.

cheap_window_hours.description: Optional length of the cheap-rate window, hours.

shiftable_evening_share.description: Optional share (0-1) of evening use the household moves to cheap hours itself, without a battery. The saving is then only what the battery adds on top.

loan_rate.description: Optional yearly loan interest rate, 0-0.5 (charged monthly).

loan_years.description: Optional loan term in years (with loan_rate).

tools.name: get_export_rates
tools.description: Export rates by UK supplier with quote, source and read date, plus suppliers still being verified.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Quoted official facts on VAT, SEG, MCS, planning, network (DNO) notification, typical costs, solar yield, self-consumption and the Boiler Upgrade Scheme.

tools.name: get_tariff_facts
tools.description: Ofgem price cap, smart time-of-use tariffs and export tariffs, quoted with read dates.

tools.name: list_batteries
tools.description: Batteries we track, with which specifications are checked and which are not yet verified.

tools.name: get_battery
tools.description: Specifications from the manufacturer's datasheet and warranty, each with quote and read date.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: The calculator model, its simplifications, sourced defaults and how to cite the site.
